title: OpenShip trends as a self-hosted platform for deploying apps and agents
friendlyTitle: OpenShip helps you host apps and AI services yourself
summary: OpenShip is an Apache-licensed self-hosted deployment platform with active development and roughly 14,200 GitHub stars. Its repository includes application, infrastructure and operational components for running services on infrastructure you control.
friendlySummary: OpenShip is a popular open-source platform for deploying services on your own infrastructure. It is actively developed and has about 14,200 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Teams building AI services can use it to explore a self-managed alternative to hosted deployment platforms, especially when data location or infrastructure control matters. Review its security and licensing boundaries before production use.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may suit teams that want more control over where their AI apps run. Check its security setup carefully before using it for real customers.
